observations: A photocopier/MFP machine wrapped in clear plastic, likely new or refurbished for sale
Control panel with buttons and small LCD visible on top right
Document feeder tray visible, paper tray visible on front
A partial brand mark reading 'SHARP' visible near the lower front panel, photo 0
No visible page counter, no drum/toner unit shown, no test print shown
No model number plate or serial sticker legible in the photo

claims.evidence: Photo shows plastic wrap, surface appears tidy, but 'clean' internally cannot be judged from one exterior shot
No sample printout or copy shown in any photo
No photo of the page/copy counter on the control panel

claims.claim: New drum and toner just fitted
claims.evidence: No photo of drum unit, toner cartridge, or purchase receipt
Cannot be tested from a static photo; requires live demonstration

risks.risk: Actual copy count may be far higher than claimed, affecting drum/fuser wear
risks.proof: Clear photo of the control panel counter/display showing total page count
risks.if_unproven: priced as high page-count / heavily used unit

risks.risk: Drum and toner may not actually be new, or may be generic/refilled
risks.proof: Photo of drum unit and toner cartridge with brand markings, or purchase receipt
risks.if_unproven: priced as original used parts, not new

risks.risk: Machine may have internal paper jam or scanning/printing fault not visible when off
risks.proof: Short video clip of it powering on and producing a test copy

risks.risk: Missing power cable, drum unit, or other accessories not shown under the plastic wrap
risks.proof: Photo of the machine unwrapped with all parts and cables laid out

risks.risk: Model variant unclear, which affects base value significantly
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the model/serial plate, usually on the side or back panel
risks.if_unproven: priced as the cheapest matching Sharp model in the comparables

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the model/serial number plate
Photo of the page counter on the control panel display
Photo of the drum unit and toner cartridge, or purchase receipt for 'new' parts
Short video of the machine powered on, making a test copy
Photo of the machine fully unwrapped, including back/power cord
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Sharp-brand low-cost multifunctional photocopier by the visible logo, but all seller claims about condition, page count, and new parts are unverified from a single wrapped exterior photo, so it must be priced at worst case against the cheapest comparable Sharp model.
